purpose: Reserve next independent event before any result acquisition; prior four events are development only
selection_reason: Different long/high-speed circuit characteristics; not selected from prediction errors or observed outcomes
candidate: Explainable visible-prefix segment median with stale/transition abstention; source and parameters frozen before acquisition

metrics.primary: candidate vs prefix_median lap MAE on exactly paired scored targets
metrics.coverage: candidate scored / applicable registered-driver cutoff slots; also retain original full fixed denominator
metrics.categories: post-event not-applicable, data/target missing, publication-boundary rejection, candidate abstention, scored; report each separately
metrics.post_event: after latest recorded positive-duration lap completion; only a posthoc event-end proxy, never supplied as a prediction feature
metrics.gap: unchanged baseline MAE plus freshness exclusions; no claim of prediction improvement

acceptance_thresholds.interpretation: All thresholds required for a positive event-specific candidate result. Otherwise report failure/inconclusive, never select another race or retune on this event. One event cannot validate live or causal strategy benefit.

acquisition: ordinary bounded GET with saved raw body/headers/receipts, no retry or alternate host; source failure is reported and event remains fixed
freeze_order: develop only on previously observed four races
